(i) we have developed a novel design for VRES that allows efficiency improvements in the protocols based on the primitive; (ii) we have developed two protocols for certified e-mail with RSA receipts, RSA-CEMD1 and RSA-CEMD2, that offer non-repudation of origin and nonrepudiation of receipt services and strong fairness to the communicating parties; (iii) RSA-CEMDi offers additional confidentiality protection for the exchanged e-mail message and receipt; and
we have designed and implemented a novel cryptographic primitive called Veriable and Recoverable Encryption (VRES) of a signature.
